[P1] Preserve recovery ownership before preparation commits

If the original invocation is interrupted after preparation is released but before its SUCCEED checkpoint persists, the default at-least-once semantics rerun `prepare()` on the next invocation. This returns the retry's request ID, admitting that retry into the victim fault and admission probes. The supplied regression interrupts only after preparation commits. Read and verify the immutable driver-owned request selection before admitting preparation, checkpoint that selected identity, and add a regression covering interruption before the preparation checkpoint.
